verdict.rationale: Exposing a machine-readable API spec is a fair axis for a self-hostable observability platform, but the pack has no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on arize.com returning 404, though it did not check a Phoenix instance itself. The llms.txt docs index and the /mcp endpoint are not API specifications, so they are not credited here.
